flux-genome-rs-main/Cargo.toml:
[package]
name = "flux-genome"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "Genetic algorithm framework for evolving musical traditions in dial space — Rust port of flux-genome"
license = "MIT"
keywords = ["genetic-algorithm", "music", "evolution", "genome", "superinstance"]
categories = ["algorithms", "science"]
repository = "https://github.com/SuperInstance/flux-genome-rs"

[dependencies]
rand = "0.8"
rand_distr = "0.4"
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
thiserror = "1"
once_cell = "1"

[dev-dependencies]
approx = "0.5"
